properties.name: King Rama VI Monument
properties.desc: Completed in 1942 at Gate 4, the park's southwest entrance, to honor King Vajiravudh (Rama VI), who gave the land for the park.

properties.name: Chinese Clock Tower
properties.desc: A Chinese-style clock tower in the southeast of the park, just inside Gate 2.

properties.name: Lumpini Discovery Learning Library
properties.desc: Bangkok's first public library. Its children's and youth zone was rebuilt in 2018 as a ladybird-shaped building.

properties.name: Paddle Boat Rental
properties.desc: The lakeside pier where you can rent a paddle boat on the lake. Sessions run 9:00–11:30 AM and 1:00–5:30 PM.

properties.name: Green Bridge to Benjakitti Park (Lumpini end)
properties.desc: An elevated walking and cycling path from the northeast corner of Lumpini Park to Benjakitti Park.

properties.name: Si Lom MRT Station (Exit 1)
properties.desc: Exit 1 of MRT Si Lom station (Blue Line), at the southwest corner of the park near Gate 4 and the King Rama VI Monument.

properties.desc: BTS Skytrain station on the Silom Line, on Si Lom Road. Gate 4 at the park's southwest corner is about a 6-minute walk.

properties.name: Lumphini Park Office
properties.desc: Lumpini Park's management office, on the east side of the park. Phone 02-252-7006.

properties.name: Public Restrooms (Gate 4)
properties.desc: Free, wheelchair-accessible public toilets near Gate 4, next to the Lumpini Recreation Center.

properties.name: Lumpini Park Running Track
properties.desc: Paths of about 2.5 km around the park, used by joggers in the morning and evening.

properties.name: Outdoor Gym
properties.desc: An open-air exercise area with fitness equipment on the west side of the park, by Ratchadamri Road.
